newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 30.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 30.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungary is again the front runner of reforms in Central Europe, Prime Minister Gyula Horn said.
- NATO will set up a new body to handle relations with the new members.
- Postabank, Hungary's second largest commercial started its annual shareholders' meeting.
- At Hungary's request, the North Atlantic Assembly will set up a subcommittee on organised crime and immigration.
